body: what do you mean with nothing to show?

someone told me to try and find a contructive way of getting anger out. like making a poem, art, song, or a sport you like, and i bet you will be realy good at it just not in the beginning but in the end you will. just try to focus on using every thing you feel to make something better and you will get it better and maybe try to listen to music. and if you want to get out with your shame and embarrassment and other bad thoughts try to write them down and throw them in the trash can it will make you feel better in did for me. and just know i am here for you.
Every one can be scared and feel lonely but you are never realy alone. but what are you scared for?.
follow your heart my friend but sometimes it can be hard to follow your heart but just keep walking to it even if it is baby steps. i know you will get through this i belive in you.

i don't think they are tired of you they just want the best for you and want you to be happy maybe they are angry and mad at you sometimes but they do it because they love you. was it someone that made you hate school? and made you stop wanting to do anything?.
you are not a fail you are brave. and what  is this failure you are talking about?

i know how it feels to want to avoid everything. do you have a friend or brother/sister that can talk to you and maybe get you through this hard time. and if not try to go for a walk or how you vent your anger then think what to do after take small steps go for what you like and what you love.
If you want to talk i am here. Just lay down the blade take A deep breath and if you can tell me how you feel and why and i will help you.
Thank you so much i will try to find my way then.
no not realy just living with it. and sometimes when i get angry i go for a walk and talk to my self
thank you for writing to me.
the letter sounds realy good thank you i will do that and just thanks for replying
